plum.$description: Headings, eyebrow, link, focus ring. 13.20:1 on page, 14.59:1 on white.

orange.$description: CTA fill. 5.06:1 with white text; 4.57:1 on page as text.

orangeStrong.$description: CTA hover AND every piece of orange text: outline button, italic emphasis, link hover. 6.82:1 with white, 6.16:1 on page, 6.82:1 on surface, 5.66:1 on bg.subtle. Replaces the separate orange-text step #9E4A34: one tone, more contrast as text (5.45 -> 6.16 on page).

teal.$description: Inverse block, featured card, status.info, brand.accent. 10.78:1 with white.

sage.$description: Decorative only — logo frame, photo border, pull quotes. 1.41:1 on page: never text.

sageLight.$description: Text and labels on teal and plum (8.34:1 on teal, 11.3:1 on plum); headings in dark mode.

cream.$description: Page, with its faint brand tint.

inkMuted.$description: Ink muted: secondary text, the neutral status. Solid, replacing the 76% alpha step. 6.92:1 on page, 7.66:1 on white.

line.$description: Line: separators and card borders. Decorative (1.45:1 on white) — never a control border; controls use border.default.

cream2.$description: The alt surface for hovers. Borrador 3 is silent on it; kept because bg.subtle consumes it. Charcoal on it: 13.95:1.

inkCaption.$description: Kept from the previous system: captions/placeholders at 4.60:1 on page, and the 3:1 control hairline. Borrador 3 does not name them; both have live consumers.

ochre.$description: Warning. The ochre that left the brand lives on here only. Too light for white text (2.30:1): a solid warning carries ink instead (7.31:1) — see status.onWarningSolid.

crimson.$description: Danger. White text 6.20:1. With magenta gone it no longer has a near neighbour.
